THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, hereby declare under Sub - section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provision of that Act.

AN Allotment of land depicted in below name and extent in the Advance Tracing No. MN/MNN/2023/501 dated 25.10.2023, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village called Kaddukarankudiyiruppu in the Grama Niladhari Division No. MN/53, of Kaddukarankudiyiruppu in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Mannar Town of Mannar District in Northern Province and bounded as follow:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Kaddukarankudiyiruppukanni – Extent: 2.8900 Hectares North, East, South and West: Kaddukarankudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known). Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/11/2023/RE/97.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Avenue, Battaramulla,14th February, 2024.
